reasons: Section 9.4 as cited grants Customer a convenience-termination right on thirty days' written notice for the Agreement or any Order Form, with a pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and no early-termination fee, and expressly denies Vendor any convenience right during a committed term — this matches the T4C preferred position on every material term.
The finding is claimed as compliant and correctly carries no redline and no counterparty comment; the rendered paragraph is unchanged from the original, so there is no over-flagging or invalid edit.
The rationale appropriately checks the rest of the document (breach/insolvency terminations in 9.1–9.3, change-of-control block in 24.4) and confirms no Vendor convenience right exists elsewhere.

The §2.1 take-or-pay 'without reduction or termination rights' tension is correctly noted as economic context and routed to the minimum-commitment rule rather than double-flagged here, consistent with the no-duplicate-flag instruction.
Deterministic check ('Customer convenience termination present') corroborates the compliant classification.
